Source: a7m3-uiprobe3.log (LDEC records from the preload shim).
b = m0..m7: m0=src VA, m1=srclen, m2=dst PA, m3=dstlen, m4=2, m5=3, m6=0, m7=0x90.
The shim decodes Sony LZ77 and writes to m2 (physical) through /dev/mem.
